---
name: Feature request
about: A change to what the channel does or how it is used
labels: enhancement
---

## The problem

What goes wrong or cannot be done today? A concrete situation between roles
helps more than a proposed API.

## What would solve it

The behaviour you have in mind, and which tools or documents it touches.

## Design rules

The channel is built by the rules in `docs/design-rules.md`
(https://github.com/jeffreyjorgensen/ai-agent-channel/blob/main/docs/design-rules.md).
If the request conflicts with one of them (for example it needs an optional
field, a timer, or a text heuristic that acts on its own), say which rule
and why it should give way.
